{{Quote|Sir! They've gone up the ventilation shaft!|Tey How|audio=How-Ventilation.flac|<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />}}
'''Tey How''' was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]] for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']]. Her [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] and [[Data goggles/Legends|data goggles]] allowed direct communication with the ship. She was also the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].

==Biography==

===Invasion of Naboo===
By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref>''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of {{Film|I}}, which depicts the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion]] and the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Tey How was stationed aboard the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']].<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> She was one of the more skilled [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] pilots,<ref name="Tey How" /> having been surgically<ref name="Coruscant Limited Tey How" /> fitted with a set of [[Data goggles/Legends|data goggles]] to facilitate her shipboard duties,<ref name="Tey How" /> including ship systems.<ref name="Insider's Guide" /> Througth them she could see constant holographic data read-outs.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

She was present when the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] attempted to break into the bridge shortly before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] began. She informed her superiors that they lost communication with the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] dispatched to ensure the Jedi were destroyed (under the belief that the [[Dioxis/Legends|dioxis]] gas [[Death/Legends|killed]] them), before sealing the bridge at Gunray's command. After Kenobi and Jinn were forced to retreat from the [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], How informed her superiors that the two Jedi had entered the ventilation shafts.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

After the invasion Gunray ordered all Trade Federation battleships but the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] to return home. He assigned Tey How to the communications station on the control ship.<ref name="Tey How" />

===Death===
[[File:DCS_Destruction.png|left|thumb|250x250px|Tey How died in the explosion of the.''[[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|Vuutun Palaa]].'']]
During the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], she was stationed aboard the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|''Vuutun Palaa'']] and under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine's]] orders launched the droid forces after the [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]], as well as activated the ground troops upon their deployment during the concurrent Battle of the Grassy Plains. After [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] destroyed the ship's main reactor with two [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] and set off a chain reaction, How made her soon-to-be-final damage report to Dofine, who dismissed it as "impossible" and that a starfighter could never have penetrated the ship's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. How was later [[Death/Legends|killed]], along with her captain and cohorts inside the ship, when the chain reaction triggered by the main reactor's destruction caused the [[Central Control Computer/Legends|control computer]] console to explode in front of the crew, just as the bridge was incinerated by the explosion.<ref name="Insider's Guide" />

==Personality and traits==
A [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Tey How" /> [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]],<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> Tey How had mottled [[Color/Legends|gray]] skin<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> and red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="The Phantom Menace 4" />

==Equipment==
How had audio and visual [[Cybernetics/Legends|mechanics]] surgically implanted to assist her in shipboard operations.<ref name="Coruscant Limited Tey How">{{CCG|set=Coruscant Limited|cardname=Tey How}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Originally created for the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> Tey How was voiced by [[Amanda Lucas]]<ref name="Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/sphere-of-influence-trivia-gallery|text="Sphere of Influence" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 3}}</ref> (credited as Tyger)<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> and an uncredited [[Marc Silk]],<ref name="Marc Silk">{{WebCite|url=http://www.marcsilk.com/biography|text=Marc Silk: Voice Actor - The Voice Of Your Imagination - biography|author=[[Marc Silk]]|archivedate=20170620123224}}</ref> aboard the ''Saak'ak'' and ''Vuutun Palaa'' respectively.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> As a result, [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] identified Silk's character as a separate Neimoidian known as [[Sil Unch]],<ref name="Theed Palace Limited Sil Unch">{{CCG|set=Theed Palace Limited|cardname=Sil Unch}}</ref> even though the screenplay had assigned his dialogue to How.<ref name="Illustrated Screenplay">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref> However, [[Leland Chee]] considered this an error, and How became the pilot of both ships as was originally intended, while Unch was [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] into a separate Neimoidian seen on the left of both vessels' bridges.<ref name="Creating & Naming">{{Facebook|username=star-wars-sourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/creating-naming-the-devious-neimoidians/676129629103814|name=Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=Jan 19, 2014|archivefile=File:NeimoidiansFacebook.pdf}}</ref>

''[[Secrets of Naboo]]'' provided Tey How as an example of a Neimoidian name.<ref name="Secrets of Naboo">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref>

In ''[[Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace 1]]'', How does not speak, with all of her dialogue having either been cut or reassigned to different characters. It is [[P-59]] who reports that Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi had escaped through a ventilation shaft, while an unidentified Neimoidian alerts Gunray of Amidala's transmission.<ref name="The Phantom Menace 1">[[Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace 1|''Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace'' 1]]</ref> This continued in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace 4]]'', where the ''Vuutun Palaa''{{'s}} imminent destruction was instead reported by a [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]] lookalike. In addition, How was mistakenly drawn with green skin and without her cybernetics, revealing her to have red eyes.<ref name="The Phantom Menace 4" />

[[Star Wars: I Am a Pilot (Random House)|''Star Wars Episode I: I Am a Pilot'']] identified How as [[Gender/Legends|male]].<ref name="I Am a Pilot">[[Star Wars: I Am a Pilot (Random House)|''Star Wars: I Am a Pilot'']]</ref>

''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]'', released in [[October]] of [[2005]], states that How is merely wearing a set of data goggles and a vocalizer as opposed to them being surgically implanted.<ref name="SWC:TP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref>
